product_scope: Original FX.finContinue and FX.finBreak catch-all finally handler; no implementation or execution.

findings.finding: NormalFlowView intentionally excludes canonical exception edges from the plain-flow graph. Its separate unreachable-component dominator forest only admits an exception-rooted single-root component with no exception target entering below the root. This can establish dominance for the handler island, but does not itself recover Java try/finally or add a handler edge to normal CFG.

named_catch_rows_for_shape refuses CatchTypes not Named, and refuses any overlapping physical exception row with catch_type_index=None. It validates exact physical range and canonical-row binding for named catches. Thus the current guard-to-region proof path cannot certify FX catch-all handler rows through this helper.

proved_loop_catch_joins requires handler rows to have a plain successor join, no normal predecessors, and rejects rows with catch_type_index=None or empty protected spans. FX handler is a catch-all terminal rethrow sequence with no plain successor after athrow, so this loop join exemption does not match.
FragmentedCatch is specifically nested named catches in loops and rejects catch-all rows up front; it is not a reusable certificate for this handler.

Existing Operation::Throw facts explicitly describe guarded-handler rethrow as evidence for exceptional finally handling. That operation-level evidence is pertinent, but the current region proof cited above does not consume it as a standalone catch-all finally certificate.

Existing focused regression asserts that adding a catch-all row to the named-catch shape returns None. This documents the boundary and should remain true for that named-catch helper; any new narrowly scoped finally path must not relax it globally.

candidate_minimal_leaf.shape: Only a handler-rooted catch-all exception component with zero ordinary predecessors; all protected-range rows mapped exactly; exception-only entry at handler; handler stores caught exception, executes modeled cleanup, reloads that same caught value, then athrows it; prove no normal edge enters handler and preserve normal inline cleanup copies independently.
candidate_minimal_leaf.scope_guard: A dedicated certificate for this exact catch-all rethrow finally shape, separate from named-catch row ownership and loop join helpers. Do not reinterpret athrow as ordinary return/join or globally accept catch-all rows.
candidate_minimal_leaf.tests: Keep original FX methods as fixed-source controls. Add a same-shape deterministic throwing protected-body fixture whose outer catch checks Throwable identity and cleanup count exactly once; retain nonthrowing continue and break cases to check BCI31 distinct targets. Compile all generated method text and run rebuilt-only with unmodified driver on Java 8 and 23. Original FX main oracle alone does not exercise a thrown path.
candidate_minimal_leaf.not_proven: No actual SSA dumps for the FX methods are emitted in the final CLI raw; the classfile and CLI report give bytecode, handler provenance and normal-flow/fallback report only. Do not claim SSA value identity from this report.

limitations: Static read only; no Cargo, CLI, JVM, Git, network or runtime execution.
The bounded candidate is an analysis/recovery target, not a product requirement or claim of existing support.
